paragraphs.text:
You break free of the pack, which tears at the bodies of your 
hapless students. That grisly diversion allows you to get a good 
head start before a few of the predators break off to give chase. 
Can you keep going until they lose interest?

Make a CON roll. If you have fewer than half your original hit 
points, you must take a penalty die. If you succeed, go to 356. If you 
fail, the Nadelmann Expedition is over. THE END.
